name: 蔡府伯
objective:
室內氣候、室外氣候、熱環境、空氣環境－汙染物、換新與通風、音環境、人體舒適度、室內空氣品質控制、潔淨室之規劃設計。
Indoor and outside air conditions, thermal environment, air pollutants, fresh air and ventilation, noise level, human confort, indoor air quality control, design of clean room.
schedule:
1	   Introduction The Atmosphere
2-3	   Atmospheric Pollutants
5-7	   Atmospheric Effects
8	   期中考
9-11   Emissions Assessment
12-13  Regulation and public policy
14-15  Indoor Air Quality
16	   期末報告
17-18  作業
scorePolicy:
作業及課堂表現: 30%
期中考 20%
期末報告 35%
彈性學習 15%
consultation: 每週二下午綜合科館 610-1 諮詢
延伸教學與資源: ● 參與式創新教學 (Participatory & Innovative Teaching) 強調學生參與與產出，導入翻轉、PBL/專題、設計思考或遊戲化等策略。Emphasizes student engagement and outcomes by adopting strategies such as Flipped Classroom, PBL (Problem/Project- Based Learning), Design Thinking, or Gamification.
課程對應SDGs指標: SDG7：可負擔的潔淨能源（Affordable and Clean Energy）SDG9：產業創新與基礎設施（Industry, Innovation and Infrastructure）
課程是否導入AI: ● 鼓勵學生使用生成式 AI 工具（Encourage students to use generative AI tools）
